title: Fix: src/adapters/secondary/fwd-discovery-adapter.ts contains Rust code (Path-B corruption)

done: File was emitted by a prior hex plan execute Path-B dispatch
Contains #[tokio::main], Box<dyn std::error::Error>, println! — pure Rust inside a .ts extension
Breaks `bun run typecheck` with ~10 TS1109/TS1005/TS1128 parse errors in that one file
Does NOT break `vite build` (Vite only compiles imported files; this file is not imported from composition-root)

notes: This is a secondary adapter for Forward Networks discovery, intended to implement a discovery port per ADR-001
The adapter MUST import only from src/core/ports/* (ADR-001 rule 5) and MUST use .js relative imports (NodeNext)

Do NOT delete the file blindly — it likely represents an in-flight feature. Rewrite it as valid TypeScript matching the existing discovery port shape (see src/adapters/secondary/docusaurus-discovery-adapter.ts as a reference implementation; ADR-013-era)

steps.description: Read src/core/ports/ to find the discovery port interface. Read src/adapters/secondary/docusaurus-discovery-adapter.ts as a concrete reference for how secondary discovery adapters are structured in this repo (imports, return types, error handling).
steps.done_condition: discovery port interface and at least one reference adapter identified

steps.description: Replace the Rust body of src/adapters/secondary/fwd-discovery-adapter.ts with a valid TypeScript implementation of the discovery port for Forward Networks. Port the *intent* of the Rust code (discover API versions, return a list) to TS. Must use .js extensions on all relative imports. Must only import from src/core/ports/* (never other adapters).
steps.done_condition: file compiles under `tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json`; zero TS parse errors in that path

steps.description: Do NOT wire the new adapter into composition-root yet — composition-root wiring is a separate change that should be gated on a behavioral spec. Instead, add a CLAUDE.md line under 'Known unwired adapters' or a brief note at the top of the file indicating it is implemented but not yet wired.
steps.done_condition: file header comment documents unwired status; composition-root.ts unchanged

steps.description: Run `bun run typecheck` — must pass. Run `hex analyze .` — adapter boundary rules must remain clean (no adapter-to-adapter imports, only ports imports allowed).
steps.done_condition: typecheck passes with zero errors; hex analyze reports no new violations

steps.description: Commit with message: `fix(adapter): rewrite fwd-discovery-adapter.ts from Rust to TypeScript`. Include in the commit body a reference to the Path-B corruption cause and the reference adapter used.
steps.done_condition: git log shows the fix commit on main
